apps.name: Scrappy
apps.author: gabrielfvale
apps.short_desc: On-device artwork scraper powered by Skyscraper backend. Built with LOVE2D.
apps.detailed_desc: Scrappy scrapes box art, screenshots, previews, and metadata directly on your muOS handheld using a Skyscraper backend. No PC required after initial setup. Supports multiple output templates, region priorities, in-app updater, and advanced tools for cache management.

apps.name: Scrappy Fork (Goose)
apps.author: community
apps.short_desc: Community fork of Scrappy updated for muOS Canada Goose / Pixie compatibility.
apps.detailed_desc: Unofficial community fork of Scrappy maintained while the original author has not yet updated for newer muOS versions. Fixes compatibility issues with Canada Goose and Pixie releases.

apps.name: Artie Scraper
apps.author: milouk
apps.short_desc: Light and fast artwork scraper for Anbernic devices running muOS.
apps.detailed_desc: Artie scrapes box art, previews, screenshots, videos, synopses, and metadata from ScreenScraper. Features multi-threaded scraping (1-20 threads), API response caching, custom PNG mask overlays, OTA updates, offline mode, and 110+ systems supported.

apps.name: Aesthetic
apps.author: cybardev / harryarry
apps.short_desc: Create minimalistic duo-tone themes directly on your handheld.
apps.detailed_desc: Aesthetic lets you create custom muOS themes directly on-device. Customize colors, fonts, RGB lighting accents, grid/list layouts, and export shareable theme files. No PC or image editing required.

apps.name: Banim
apps.author: community
apps.short_desc: Boot animation system for muOS and other Linux handhelds.
apps.detailed_desc: Banim adds a boot animation system to muOS using an optimized sequence of frames. Includes the banim_pak tool to create custom animations from video files or image sequences. Supports Knulli and muOS.

apps.name: Bootlogo Manager
apps.author: community
apps.short_desc: Easily install and switch between boot logos on your muOS device.
apps.detailed_desc: Bootlogo Manager allows you to install custom boot logos and easily switch between them. Automatically backs up the original logo before making changes so you can restore anytime.

apps.name: Bluetooth App
apps.author: nvcuong1312
apps.short_desc: Manage Bluetooth connections on muOS devices. Scan, pair, and connect controllers, headphones, keyboards.
apps.detailed_desc: Full Bluetooth management for muOS. Scan for devices, pair controllers, headphones, and keyboards. Supports audio output switching with volume control. Two connection methods: Expect and None Expect. Requires WiFi to be enabled for Bluetooth to start. Auto-updates via Task Toolkit loader.

apps.name: WiFi Manager
apps.author: community
apps.short_desc: Manage multiple WiFi network connections with saved profiles and auto-connect.
apps.detailed_desc: WiFi Manager allows you to save multiple WiFi network profiles, auto-connect to known networks, and switch between them easily. Essential for users who move between different networks.

apps.name: WiFi HotSpot
apps.author: nvcuong1312
apps.short_desc: Create a WiFi hotspot on your muOS device to share internet connection.
apps.detailed_desc: Turn your muOS handheld into a WiFi hotspot. Share your device's internet connection with other devices like laptops, phones, or other handhelds.

apps.name: CTupe
apps.author: nvcuong1312
apps.short_desc: Watch and download YouTube videos on muOS. No API key needed.
apps.detailed_desc: CTupe is a lightweight YouTube player for muOS. Search, watch, and download videos directly on your handheld. No YouTube API key required. Supports offline mode, seek controls, history, and mute.

apps.name: IPTVViewer
apps.author: community
apps.short_desc: Watch live TV and listen to radio online via m3u playlists.
apps.detailed_desc: IPTVViewer lets you watch live TV streams and listen to online radio on your muOS device. Works with remote m3u lists and local playlists. Simple and lightweight interface optimized for handheld screens.

apps.name: qtWebBrowser
apps.author: community
apps.short_desc: Web browser for muOS based on Qt WebEngine.
apps.detailed_desc: A full web browser for muOS powered by Qt WebEngine. Browse the internet on your handheld device. Supports basic navigation, bookmarks, and multiple tabs. Best used with a Bluetooth keyboard for text input.

apps.name: RT Tailscale
apps.author: SilverCrow2323
apps.short_desc: Tailscale VPN app for muOS. Secure mesh networking with Taildrop file sharing.
apps.detailed_desc: RT Tailscale adds Tailscale to the muOS Applications menu, enabling secure mesh VPN networking between your handheld and other devices. Supports Taildrop for sending and receiving files across your Tailscale network.

apps.name: Syncthing + Tailscale
apps.author: community
apps.short_desc: Automated save synchronization with Tailscale VPN integration.
apps.detailed_desc: Syncthing + Tailscale is an automated, battery-friendly synchronization engine for muOS. Seamlessly syncs game saves and save states in the background over a Tailscale VPN tunnel.

apps.name: Grout
apps.author: rommapp
apps.short_desc: Official RomM client for Linux handhelds. Sync ROMs, saves, and states.
apps.detailed_desc: Grout is the official RomM client for Linux retro handhelds. Download and manage games from your RomM instance directly on-device. Syncs ROMs, saves, and states bidirectionally. Supports muOS, NextUI, Knulli, Spruce, MinUI, Batocera, and more.

apps.name: RomM (Legacy)
apps.author: rommapp
apps.short_desc: Legacy RomM client for muOS. SUNSETTED — replaced by Grout.
apps.detailed_desc: The original RomM app for muOS. Connects to your RomM instance to browse and download games wirelessly. This app has been sunsetted as of January 2026 and replaced by Grout. No further releases or bug fixes are planned.

apps.name: Rockbox
apps.author: IncognitoMan
apps.short_desc: Full-featured music player based on Rockbox firmware. FLAC, MP3, OGG, themes, equalizer.
apps.detailed_desc: Rockbox brings a full-featured music player experience to muOS. Supports FLAC, MP3, OGG, and more. Features custom themes, graphic equalizer, playlist management, Bluetooth media key support, and lid-close playback. Based on the legendary Rockbox firmware.

apps.name: APlayer
apps.author: vasinsky
apps.short_desc: Lightweight music player for MP3, OGG, WAV, FLAC with 7 EQ presets.
apps.detailed_desc: APlayer is a lightweight music player supporting MP3, OGG, WAV, and FLAC. Features 3 listening modes, 7 EQ presets, shuffle, loop, and a pocket lock feature to prevent accidental button presses while music plays in your pocket.

apps.name: XMPlayer
apps.author: thescriptor
apps.short_desc: All-in-one XMB-inspired media suite with music, video, photos, and web radio.
apps.detailed_desc: XMPlayer is an all-in-one media center for muOS with a familiar XMB-inspired interface. Includes music player, video player (MPV), photo viewer, file browser, web radio streaming, and customizable themes. A complete media hub for your handheld.

apps.name: Tiny Podcaster
apps.author: krupkat
apps.short_desc: Minimalistic podcast player with background audio service.
apps.detailed_desc: Tiny Podcaster is a minimalistic podcast player with a background audio service. Specify your podcast subscriptions in a config file, then play episodes in the background while you game. Built with ImGui, SDL2, and cURL. Supports muOS and Knulli.

apps.name: DinoJam
apps.author: community
apps.short_desc: Audio/Video DJing app for muOS. Mix and play media like a DJ.
apps.detailed_desc: DinoJam brings DJ-style mixing to your muOS handheld. Mix audio and video tracks, apply effects, and create playlists. A fun experimental app for media enthusiasts who want to do more than just play files.

apps.name: Spotify Connect
apps.author: JanTrueno / hmcneill46
apps.short_desc: Stream music from Spotify Premium to your muOS device via Spotify Connect.
apps.detailed_desc: Spotify Connect uses librespot to turn your muOS handheld into a Spotify Connect receiver. Stream music directly from your Spotify Premium account. Control playback from your phone or PC. Available through PortMaster.

apps.name: PocketStream
apps.author: fspasovski
apps.short_desc: Lightweight Twitch client for browsing and watching live streams on muOS.
apps.detailed_desc: PocketStream is a lightweight Twitch client for muOS. Browse top live streams, search by keyword, and watch Twitch content directly on your handheld. Optimized for small screens and controller navigation.

apps.name: vTree
apps.author: MustardOS
apps.short_desc: Gamepad-driven twin-panel file manager built in C with SDL2.
apps.detailed_desc: vTree is a gamepad-driven twin-panel file manager built in C with SDL2. Features single or dual-pane explorer, copy/cut/paste/rename/delete, symlink creation, multi-select, text/hex/image viewers, themes, font selection, configurable key bindings, and script execution. The definitive file manager for muOS.

apps.name: vaixTerm
apps.author: Stanley00
apps.short_desc: SDL2 terminal emulator with ANSI/VT100, 256-color, UTF-8, and on-screen keyboard.
apps.detailed_desc: vaixTerm is a robust SDL2 terminal emulator designed for handheld gaming devices. Supports ANSI/VT100 escape codes, 256-color and True Color palettes, UTF-8, scrollback buffer, and a customizable on-screen keyboard. All functions mapped to game controller. File-based theming and OSK layout customization.

apps.name: Rgterm
apps.author: community
apps.short_desc: Minimalist terminal emulator built from scratch for muOS on Anbernic devices.
apps.detailed_desc: Rgterm is a minimalist terminal emulator built from scratch specifically for muOS on Anbernic handheld devices. Lightweight, controller-friendly, and optimized for the limited resources of retro handhelds. A fresh alternative to SimpleTerminal and vaixTerm.

apps.name: Play Time Tracker
apps.author: community
apps.short_desc: Track and analyze your gaming sessions. View total playtime and export stats.
apps.detailed_desc: Play Time Tracker records and analyzes your gaming sessions on muOS. View total playtime, average session length, most played games, launch counts, and export statistics to HTML for sharing. A dedicated tool for gamers who love data.

apps.name: How Long to Beat
apps.author: community
apps.short_desc: Scan all your ROMs and estimate total completion time for backlog management.
apps.detailed_desc: How Long to Beat scans your entire ROM library and estimates the total time required to complete all your games. Uses data from HowLongToBeat.com. Great for backlog management and setting realistic gaming goals. See exactly how many hours of content you own.

apps.name: App Downloader
apps.author: andersmmg
apps.short_desc: Download muOS community apps straight from your handheld. Like HomeBrew for muOS.
apps.detailed_desc: App Downloader is like HomeBrew for muOS. Browse and download community apps directly from your handheld without a PC. Loads apps from an apps_listing.json file and downloads from GitHub releases. Self-updating. The easiest way to discover and install new muOS apps.

apps.name: BGM Normalizer
apps.author: community
apps.short_desc: Normalize background music volume on muOS and PC. Anime-inspired UI.
apps.detailed_desc: BGM Normalizer normalizes the volume of background music (BGM) on muOS handhelds and PCs. Features an interface inspired by anime title cards with real-time progress tracking. Ensures consistent volume levels across all your menu music tracks.

apps.name: Calculator
apps.author: aciddev
apps.short_desc: A simple but overengineered calculator app for muOS. Written in pure C with themes.
apps.detailed_desc: Calculator is a feature-rich calculator app for muOS written in pure C. Supports basic and scientific operations, multiple themes (including Noir and Catppuccin), theme persistence, and a clean UI. DPAD moves cursor, A selects, X backspaces, Start equals, Select opens menu.

apps.name: Void Desk
apps.author: SilverCrow2323
apps.short_desc: Multifunctional AIO Hub with complete Linux Desktop Environments for muOS Jacaranda.
apps.detailed_desc: Void Desk is a multifunctional AIO Hub that brings complete Linux Desktop Environments to muOS Jacaranda. Transform your handheld into a pocket Linux workstation with full desktop capabilities, window manager, and productivity tools. Requires Jacaranda or newer.

apps.name: muOS Radio
apps.author: community
apps.short_desc: Internet radio app for muOS handhelds. Browse and stream online stations.
apps.detailed_desc: muOS Radio is an internet radio streaming app built in Python for muOS handhelds. Browse stations, save favorites, and stream audio directly on your device. A lightweight alternative to XMPlayer for radio-only listening.

apps.name: LocalSend Handheld
apps.author: community
apps.short_desc: LocalSend-compatible client for retro handhelds. Send and receive files over Wi-Fi.
apps.detailed_desc: A LocalSend-compatible client built in Rust for retro handhelds including muOS. Send and receive files wirelessly over your local network without internet. Compatible with the LocalSend protocol v2.1. No cloud, no servers, just direct device-to-device transfers.

apps.name: Servo Browser
apps.author: community
apps.short_desc: Experimental gamepad-native web browser built in Rust with Servo engine and SDL2.
apps.detailed_desc: An experimental web browser for handhelds, desktops, and Android built in Rust using the Servo rendering engine and SDL2. Gamepad-native controls, no touch required. Highly parallel and memory-safe thanks to Rust. Still in early development but promising for handheld web browsing.

games.name: GAMES
games.description: Native games and ports for muOS (NOT emulators)

apps.name: 2048 Plus
apps.author: saitamasahil
apps.short_desc: Feature-packed 2048 puzzle game for muOS. Multiple modes, achievements, themes.
apps.detailed_desc: A feature-packed implementation of the classic 2048 puzzle game for muOS, built using the LOVE framework. Features Classic, Plus Mode (with Bomb, Swap, and Undo powerups), and 4 Arcade Modes (Time Attack, 5x5 Huge, No Mercy, Goose). 28 unlockable achievements, 30 custom themes, embedded lo-fi BGM, CRT shader, and auto-save after every move.

apps.name: OpenCrossing
apps.author: community
apps.short_desc: Animal Crossing running natively at ~60 fps on Anbernic handhelds. No emulator.
apps.detailed_desc: OpenCrossing is a GameCube decompilation port of Animal Crossing running natively at ~60 fps on Anbernic H700 family devices (RG-34XX/35XX/28XX). No emulator required. Distributed via PortMaster for muOS, Knulli, and other CFWs. A technical marvel for retro handhelds.

apps.name: 32blit Games Collection
apps.author: joyrider3774
apps.short_desc: Collection of 40+ 32blit SDK games running through SDL2 on muOS AARCH64 devices.
apps.detailed_desc: A collection of 40+ games built with the 32blit SDK, ported to run through SDL2 on muOS AARCH64 devices. Includes match3, dots, amaze, armadillo, TowerDefense, Solitaire, minesweeper, 2048, Ping, Super-Square-Bros, and many more. Extract zips into a ROMS folder and assign the External/Ports core.

apps.name: Pyxel Games Collection
apps.author: joyrider3774
apps.short_desc: Collection of 60+ Pyxel game engine games curated for muOS with gamepad controls.
apps.detailed_desc: A curated collection of 60+ games made with the Pyxel game engine, sourced from GitHub and itch.io, compiled and tested for muOS. Many games have custom gamepad controls added. Includes a catalog .muxzip for screenshots. Requires the Pyxel core (available via Core Downloader).

apps.name: Crisp Game Library
apps.author: joyrider3774 / abagames
apps.short_desc: Collection of classic arcade-style mini-games ported to 32blit for muOS.
apps.detailed_desc: The Crisp Game Library Portable by abagames, ported to 32blit SDK for muOS. Features 16+ original games plus extra ports including Thunder, Reflector, and more. Supports hires/lores mode switching, mouse simulation, and per-game hiscore saving. A perfect arcade fix for short play sessions.

apps.name: Archive Manager
apps.author: MustardOS
apps.short_desc: Built-in package manager for apps, themes, updates, and system packages.
apps.detailed_desc: Archive Manager is muOS's built-in package manager. Install third-party apps (.muxapp), themes (.muxthm), updates (.muxupd), and system packages (.muxzip) directly from your SD card's ARCHIVE folder. The primary method for extending your muOS installation.

apps.name: Dingux Commander
apps.author: MustardOS
apps.short_desc: Two-column file manager (Norton Commander style) with full filesystem access.
apps.detailed_desc: Dingux Commander is a classic two-panel file manager inspired by Norton Commander. Provides full filesystem access for advanced users. Use with caution as it allows deletion and modification of system files. Essential for manual configuration and file management.

apps.name: Task Toolkit
apps.author: MustardOS
apps.short_desc: Collection of system maintenance scripts. Clear caches, restore configs, diagnostics.
apps.detailed_desc: Task Toolkit is a collection of essential system maintenance scripts for muOS. Clear application caches, restore default configurations, manage storage, run diagnostics, and safely mount/unmount drives. Includes loaders for apps like Bluetooth and CTupe that auto-update from GitHub.

apps.name: RGB Controller
apps.author: MustardOS / DanjelRicci
apps.short_desc: Control RGB lighting on supported devices. Includes RGB Screen React.
apps.detailed_desc: RGB Controller manages the RGB lighting on supported muOS devices. Set colors, effects, brightness, and animation patterns. Also available on non-RGB systems for theme configuration. Includes RGB Screen React which syncs lighting to screen content.

apps.name: Core Downloader
apps.author: MustardOS
apps.short_desc: Download additional emulator cores directly on-device.
apps.detailed_desc: Core Downloader lets you download additional RetroArch emulator cores directly on your muOS device. Assign cores to content folders to expand system compatibility. Essential for adding support for systems not included in the base installation.

apps.name: Theme Downloader
apps.author: MustardOS
apps.short_desc: Download themes directly on-device from the official muOS theme repository.
apps.detailed_desc: Theme Downloader connects to the official muOS theme repository at theme.muos.dev. Browse, preview, and install .muxthm theme files directly on your device without a PC. The easiest way to customize your muOS look and feel.

apps.name: Moonlight
apps.author: moonlight-stream
apps.short_desc: Open-source game streaming client. Stream PC games to your handheld.
apps.detailed_desc: Moonlight is an open-source NVIDIA GameStream client that lets you stream and control PC games directly to your muOS handheld. Requires Sunshine or GeForce Experience running on your PC. Low latency, high quality streaming with full controller support.

apps.name: PPSSPP
apps.author: MustardOS
apps.short_desc: PSP emulator enabling high-definition gameplay of PlayStation Portable content.
apps.detailed_desc: PPSSPP is the leading PSP emulator, pre-installed on muOS. Play PlayStation Portable games in high definition with enhanced textures, save states, and controller mapping. Supports ISO and CSO formats.

apps.name: ScummVM
apps.author: MustardOS
apps.short_desc: Run classic graphical adventure and RPG games. Requires original data files.
apps.detailed_desc: ScummVM allows you to run classic point-and-click adventure games and RPGs on muOS. Supports LucasArts, Sierra, Revolution, and many more engines. Requires original game data files. Pre-installed and ready to use.

apps.name: RetroArch
apps.author: MustardOS
apps.short_desc: Frontend for emulators, game engines, and media players. The backbone of muOS.
apps.detailed_desc: RetroArch is the universal frontend for emulators, game engines, and media players. It is the backbone of muOS emulation, providing a unified interface for all cores. Features shaders, netplay, rewind, save states, and extensive customization. Pre-installed.

apps.name: PortMaster
apps.author: PortsMaster
apps.short_desc: Download and install 500+ game ports for Linux handhelds.
apps.detailed_desc: PortMaster is the crown jewel of muOS. Download and install over 500 PC game ports including Stardew Valley, Undertale, Balatro, Celeste, Hollow Knight, and many more. Each port includes optimized controls for handheld devices. Requires original game files for most titles.

apps.name: SFTP + Filebrowser
apps.author: MustardOS
apps.short_desc: Web-based file manager + SFTP server. Browse and manage files remotely.
apps.detailed_desc: SFTP + Filebrowser provides remote file management for muOS. Access a web-based file manager on port 9090 or connect via SFTP on port 2022. Browse, upload, download, and manage your device's filesystem from any PC on the same network.

apps.name: Secure Shell (SSH)
apps.author: MustardOS
apps.short_desc: Remote command line access via SSH. Port 22, username root, password root.
apps.detailed_desc: SSH provides secure remote command-line access to your muOS device. Default port 22, username root, password root. Essential for advanced users, developers, and anyone who needs to edit configuration files or run commands remotely. Enable in Web Services settings.

apps.name: Virtual Terminal
apps.author: MustardOS
apps.short_desc: Browser-accessible shell terminal through local network. WebUI on port 8080.
apps.detailed_desc: Virtual Terminal provides a browser-accessible shell through your local network. Open any web browser and navigate to your device's IP on port 8080. No SSH client needed. Perfect for quick commands from any device with a browser.

apps.name: Syncthing
apps.author: MustardOS
apps.short_desc: Continuous file synchronization between devices. WebUI on port 7070.
apps.detailed_desc: Syncthing provides continuous, bidirectional file synchronization between your muOS device and other devices. Sync saves, states, ROMs, and any other files. WebUI accessible on port 7070. Enable in Web Services settings and pair with your other devices.

pc_mobile.name: PC & MOBILE TOOLS
pc_mobile.description: Tools for PC, Android, or other platforms

apps.name: EtchDroid
apps.author: etchdroid
apps.short_desc: Android app to flash muOS images to SD cards directly from your phone.
apps.detailed_desc: EtchDroid is an Android app that lets you flash muOS .img files directly to an SD card using your phone. No PC required for installation. Select the downloaded muOS image and your SD card, then flash. Essential for users who don't have easy access to a PC.

apps.name: Raspberry Pi Imager
apps.author: Raspberry Pi Foundation
apps.short_desc: Official recommended tool for flashing muOS images to SD cards on PC.
apps.detailed_desc: Raspberry Pi Imager is the officially recommended tool for flashing muOS images to SD cards. Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. Simply select the muOS .img.gz file and your SD card, then write. Most user-friendly tool with the highest chance of success according to the muOS team.

apps.name: Rufus
apps.author: pbatard
apps.short_desc: Lightweight Windows tool for flashing muOS images to USB drives and SD cards.
apps.detailed_desc: Rufus is a lightweight Windows utility for creating bootable USB drives and flashing SD cards. Supports muOS .img files. Faster than many alternatives and supports various partition schemes. A solid alternative to Raspberry Pi Imager on Windows.

wip.name: WORK IN PROGRESS
wip.description: Projects in development without stable release

apps.name: Dolphin (Core)
apps.author: Speedrun / community
apps.short_desc: GameCube and Wii emulator port for muOS. Experimental.
apps.detailed_desc: Dolphin core brings GameCube and Wii emulation to muOS. This is an experimental port with performance varying by device. Best experienced on higher-end Anbernic models (RG40XXH, RG CubeXX). Requires BIOS files and original game images. Still in active testing.

apps.name: SimpleTerminal
apps.author: haoict
apps.short_desc: Legacy terminal app for muOS. Superseded by vaixTerm and Rgterm.
apps.detailed_desc: SimpleTerminal was the original terminal emulator for muOS. It is now largely superseded by vaixTerm and Rgterm which offer more features and better compatibility. Still functional on older muOS versions if you prefer a simpler tool. No longer actively maintained.

apps.name: muOS Tailscale GUI
apps.author: community
apps.short_desc: Native GUI app for connecting muOS devices to Tailscale tailnet. QR auth, Taildrop.
apps.detailed_desc: A native GUI app for connecting your muOS devices to your Tailscale tailnet. Browse your peers, send/receive files via Taildrop, and authenticate via QR code — all from your handheld. Built in Python. Still in early development but functional for basic Tailscale operations.

apps.name: KantOS Theme
apps.author: community
apps.short_desc: Pokemon Kanto-inspired theme for muOS. Work in progress.
apps.detailed_desc: KantOS is a work-in-progress theme for muOS inspired by the Kanto region of Pokemon. Features custom colors, glyphs, and backgrounds themed around the original Pokemon games. Not yet released as a complete .muxthm package but available for early adopters.

apps.name: JohtOS Theme
apps.author: community
apps.short_desc: Pokemon Johto-inspired theme for muOS. Work in progress.
apps.detailed_desc: JohtOS is a work-in-progress theme for muOS inspired by the Johto region of Pokemon. Features custom colors, glyphs, and backgrounds themed around Pokemon Gold/Silver/Crystal. Companion to KantOS. Still in development.
